“The laws of physics are the same for all observers in inertial reference frames.”

(i)  what is meant by an inertial frame of reference.  [1]
(ii)  the other postulate of special relativity.  [1]

I2.  This question is about the use of ultrasound for diagnostic imaging.
(a)  Outline how ultrasound is produced for use in diagnostic imaging.  [3]
(b)  In order to look for damage to the chambers of the heart, ultrasound is used to form an
image of the heart.
Suggest why it is better to use ultrasound rather than X-rays.  [2]
(c)  The speed of sound in skin is about five times the speed of sound in air.  Given that
the density of skin is about 700 times that of the density of air, compare the acoustic
impedance of skin to that of air.  [2]
(d)  Explain, using your answer to (c), why, in using ultrasound for imaging, a layer of gel is
placed between the transducer and the skin.  [2]
(e)  A wide range of frequencies of ultrasound may be used to image internal body organs.
The choice of frequency for imaging a particular organ is determined by the depth of the
organ beneath the skin.
Outline, with reference to attenuation and resolution, why the depth of the organ
determines the choice of ultrasound frequency.  [4]

charged particles to be made much larger than in a cyclotron.  [1]
